essence: The hūṃ-syllable, as the form of Bhavānī's power, guards the heart.
Kharvā, the fear-removing goddess-lord, guards the cheeks.
The tiger-skin-clad goddess, beloved of Śiva, guards the hip.
The red-round-eyed goddess continually guards the hip region.
The terrible-mouthed goddess, beloved of Hara, continually guards the generative organ.
